templates.name: EMA trend
templates.description: Fast EMA crosses above slow EMA with RSI filter (conservative reference).

templates.name: RSI mean reversion
templates.description: Long when RSI is at or below 30; ATR stop and reward/risk target.

templates.name: MACD trend
templates.description: MACD line crosses above signal; ATR stop and reward/risk target.

templates.name: Bollinger mean reversion
templates.description: Long when close is at or below the lower band; ATR stop and target.

templates.name: Donchian breakout
templates.description: Long when close crosses above the prior 20-bar Donchian high (offset 1); ATR stop and reward/risk target.

templates.name: Supertrend trend
templates.description: Long when Supertrend(10, 3) flips to an uptrend and ADX(14) is at least 20; ATR stop and reward/risk target.

templates.name: Squeeze breakout
templates.description: Long when close crosses above the upper Bollinger band right after the bands sat inside the Keltner channel (prior-bar squeeze); ATR stop and target.

templates.name: Z-score mean reversion
templates.description: Long when the 20-bar close z-score is at or below -2 in a ranging regime (ADX below 20 or Choppiness above 61.8); ATR stop and target.

templates.name: EMA trend hold
templates.description: Long when EMA(20) crosses above EMA(100); hold until it crosses back below (signal exit). 3x ATR initial stop, no take-profit, wide 5x ATR trail.
